Typowy proces zaczyna się od briefu i re: A typical process starts with a brief and research and ends with handing over the approved files. In between, the provider prepares the visual direction and concepts, the client makes decisions and the chosen proposal is refined.<1><2>[2]</2></1><3><4>[3]</4></3><5><6>[4]</6></5><7><8>[5]</8></7><9><10>[7]</10></9>
<1>Brief i research.</1> Strony ustalają: <1>Brief and research.</1> The parties agree the goal, the brand context, the project's applications and the scope of materials needed. The result should be a shared understanding of the task.
<1>Kierunek wizualny.</1> Określany jest: <1>Visual direction.</1> The character of the future system is defined, for example its typography, colors and general style. This is the stage of choosing a direction, not a finished logo.
<1>Koncepcje.</1> Projektant prezentuje: <1>Concepts.</1> The designer presents solutions based on the agreed assumptions. The client chooses the direction to be developed.
<1>Poprawki i akceptacja.</1> Uwagi są z: <1>Revisions and approval.</1> Comments are gathered in rounds, and the chosen concept is refined within the agreed scope.
<1>Finalizacja.</1> Po zatwierdzeniu prz: <1>Finalization.</1> After approval, the final files are prepared, and with a broader identity also the documentation of the brand's usage rules.
Harmonogram jest bardziej użyteczny, gdy: A schedule is more useful when it specifies the expected result and the person responsible for approval at each stage. The end date alone doesn't show how much time was allocated to the client's decisions. The relationship between the mark's applications and design decisions is presented in more detail in <1>the process of designing a functional logo</1>.
Trzeba też rozróżnić makiety prezentacyj: You also need to distinguish presentation mockups from files intended for use. The proposal should specify which materials will be handed over after approval, instead of leaving the scope of finalization open to interpretation.
Dodatkowa runda poprawek może przesunąć: An additional round of revisions can shift the deadline, especially when the comments change a previously approved direction.<1><2>[6]</2></1><3><4>[7]</4></3><5><6>[8]</6></5> However, the sources don't indicate a universal number of days needed for one round, so a fixed conversion rate shouldn't be applied.
Runda poprawek powinna oznaczać zbiorczy: A round of revisions should mean a consolidated set of comments and the designer's response within an agreed stage. A minor correction of spacing or proportions in a chosen concept is refinement. A request for a completely different style after the direction has been approved may, however, require going back to concept work.
Z tego powodu sama liczba rund nie opisu: For this reason, the number of rounds alone doesn't describe the whole risk. What also matters is the scope of permitted comments, how they're submitted and what the parties consider a change beyond the earlier arrangements. These rules should be included in the proposal or contract.
Termin zależy głównie od zakresu projekt: The timeline depends mainly on the project scope, the number of decisions and the pace of feedback. The most common sources of delay are late or contradictory comments, the lack of a single decision-maker, an unclear brief and adding new elements during the work.<1><2>[1]</2></1><3><4>[4]</4></3><5><6>[6]</6></5><7><8>[7]</8></7>
Osoba decyzyjna nie musi samodzielnie tw: The decision-maker doesn't have to write all the comments themselves. Their role is to gather the positions and pass one consistent decision on to the designer. When several people send separate and contradictory comments, it's harder to close a stage and start the next one.
Jeżeli marka ma być gotowa na konkretny: If the brand has to be ready by a specific date, the schedule needs to be planned backwards from the rollout date. It should cover both the provider's work and the time the client needs for consultations and approvals. However, it's impossible to set one right buffer for all projects.
Przy rebrandingu szczególne znaczenie ma: With a rebrand, it's especially important to separate the project completion date from the rollout date. Preparing a visual system doesn't automatically mean that all materials and channels will be updated at the same moment.

Najsprawniej działa feedback zebrany w j: Feedback gathered into one consistent round of comments works most efficiently. Minor corrections to the chosen direction are something different from going back to the concept stage and preparing a new style.
Przed rozpoczęciem współpracy trzeba spr: Before starting the collaboration, you need to check whether the stated timeline includes waiting for feedback and approvals, or only the designer's active work.<1><2>[3]</2></1><3><4>[5]</4></3><5><6>[6]</6></5><7><8>[7]</8></7> Not all sources define this counting method explicitly, so it has to be clarified in the project documents.

Czy termin jest podany w dniach roboczyc: Is the timeline given in business days, calendar days or as active working time?
Czy harmonogram uwzględnia terminy na pr: Does the schedule include deadlines for submitting comments and approving stages?
Ile rund poprawek obejmuje ustalony zakr: How many revision rounds does the agreed scope include, and how is one round defined?
Co stanie się z harmonogramem po zmianie: What happens to the schedule after a change to the approved direction?
Jak będą rozliczane dodatkowe materiały: How will additional materials and changes beyond the scope be billed?
Kto po stronie klienta przekazuje skonso: Who on the client's side passes on consolidated feedback and approves the stages?
Liczbę rund, sposób zgłaszania uwag oraz: The number of rounds, the way comments are submitted and the rules for billing additional changes should be written down before the project starts.<1><2>[6]</2></1><3><4>[7]</4></3><5><6>[8]</6></5> The contract template referred to is only an example of how such provisions can be organized and doesn't constitute legal advice.
Niejasny harmonogram można rozpoznać po: An unclear schedule can be recognized by the lack of a scope, approval points, a number of rounds and conditions for moving the deadline. When comparing proposals, these elements should be analyzed separately from <1>the costs of a company logo design</1>, because price and time describe different aspects of the order.
Ryzyko przesunięcia terminu można ograni: The risk of the deadline shifting can be limited by closing the brief, appointing one person responsible for decisions, submitting consolidated comments and confirming the rules for changes before starting the next stage.<1><2>[6]</2></1><3><4>[7]</4></3><5><6>[8]</6></5>
Zbierz komentarze wszystkich zainteresow: Gather the comments of everyone involved before sending them to the designer.
Oddziel korekty wybranej koncepcji od pr: Separate corrections to the chosen concept from a request for a new direction.
Akceptuj etapy zgodnie z ustalonym harmo: Approve stages according to the agreed schedule.
Jeżeli pojawiają się nowe materiały, pot: If new materials come up, confirm the change of scope and deadline.
Przed finalizacją zweryfikuj listę przek: Before finalization, verify the list of files to be delivered.
Takie działania nie gwarantują dotrzyman: Such actions don't guarantee that the original date will be met, especially when the project scope changes during the work. However, they help limit repeated decisions and make it easier to recognize the moment when refining the design turns into a new task.
Ostatecznie termin trzeba oceniać przez: Ultimately, the timeline has to be assessed through two things: the actual scope of delivery and the readiness of both parties to make decisions. The time ranges remain indicative, because providers define packages, stages and terms of collaboration differently.
